gizmo.title: Su'aal tiro
gizmo.description: Su'aal lagaga jawaabo tiro. Jawaabtu waa tiro go'an ama qaacido laga xisaabiyo doorsoomayaal, waxaana la tiriyaa marka ay ku jirto xad dulqaad.

configure.title: Su'aal
configure.description: Waxa ardayda la weydiinayo. Ku qor magaca doorsoome qaansooyin qalloocan, sida {d}, si aad u muujiso qiimihiisa.

configure.title: Cabbir
configure.description: Wuxuu u muuqdaa qoraal ku ag yaal goobta jawaabta, tusaale km/h.

configure.title: Jawaab
configure.description: Tirada saxda ah. Ka tag madhan marka qaacido xisaabiso jawaabta.

configure.title: Qaacido
configure.description: Wuxuu jawaabta ka xisaabiyaa doorsoomayaasha, tusaale d / (t / 60). Wuxuu isticmaali karaa + - * / ^, qaansooyin, sqrt() iyo abs(). Waxaa loo isticmaalaa halkii jawaabta marka la dejiyo.

configure.title: Doorsoomayaasha
configure.description: Tirooyinka qaacidada iyo su'aashu isticmaalaan. Mid kastaa wuxuu qaataa qiime u dhexeeya kan ugu hooseeya iyo kan ugu sarreeya, tallaabooyin ahaan.

advanced.title: Dulqaad
advanced.description: Inta ay jawaabta saxda ah ka fogaan karto oo weli la tiriyo. 0 macnaheedu waa sax, ama loo soo koobay meelaha jajab tobanlaha hoose.

advanced.title: Nooca dulqaadka
advanced.description: Go'an: plus ama minus dulqaadka. Boqolley: plus ama minus boqolleydaas jawaabta saxda ah.

advanced.title: Meelaha jajab tobanlaha
advanced.description: Ardayda waxaa laga codsadaa inay u soo koobaan inta meelood, jawaabtana waa la muujiyaa iyadoo loo soo koobay. Ka tag madhan si aan loo soo koobin.

advanced.title: Isku dayada
advanced.description: Immisa jeer ayuu ardaygu hubin karaa. 0 macnaheedu waa xad la'aan.

advanced.title: Tirooyin cusub isku day kasta
advanced.description: Keen qiimayaal doorsoome oo cusub mar kasta oo ardaygu isku dayo mar kale. Jawaabtoodii hore markaas lama muujiyo markay soo noqdaan, kaliya inay saxeen iyo in kale.

advanced.title: La isku duubi karo
advanced.description: U muuji su'aashan sida saf la furo oo la xiro. Furitaanka mid wuxuu xiraa su'aalaha kale ee la isku duubi karo ee agtiisa ah.

advanced.title: Ku bilow isagoo duuban
advanced.description: Marka la isku duubi karo, ku bilow saf xiran oo muujiya su'aasha iyo xaaladdeeda oo keliya.

developer.title: Magaca kedisada
developer.description: Magaca kedisada loo isticmaalo aqoonsiga xAPI ee nidaamyada falanqaynta.
